title: Scalar array elements do not all satisfy array-key value contracts

ground_truth.statement: In array<array-key>, the one type argument describes values, not keys. The allowed values are int|string. A scalar array may contain false, violating that value contract and failing the string branch of the consumer under strict_types. Integer values are handled separately and are valid.

provenance.derivation: Removed suppression; real producer returns a bool on one branch. Retained the actual one-argument array<array-key> value contract.

notes: Existing arrays/array-key-for-string-key cites this lead but measures a different key-dimension contract. This faithful value variant shares arrays/element-value-type-contract with scalar-array-for-string-array rather than claiming extra criterion coverage.
